decision_conditions: The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Location Plan, Design and Access Statement, reasonable exception
statement, Ecology report, 2382-E301, 2382-E302, 2382-P401 rev B, 2382-P402 rev
A<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-bidi-font-family:
&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p>The flats hereby permitted shall be used for Class C3
dwellinghouse(s) only and notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and
Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any
Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no
development within Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall take place</p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>Prior to the occupation of the development, details
for a scheme of hard and soft landscaping works for the site shall be submitted
to, and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Details shall
include the provision of an area of soft landscaping directly to the front of
the building’s ground floor front bay windows for planting. The submitted
details shall include: planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), and
schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers /
densities, written specification of planting.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top:5.0pt;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:5.0pt;
margin-left:0cm;mso-pagination:widow-orphan">Prior
to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, a Fire Safety
Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will
function in terms of the following:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 14.2pt;">1) identify suitably
positioned unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned
on b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 13pt;">2) is designed to
incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of
serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems
and passive and active fire safety measures <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 13pt;">3) is constructed in
an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 13pt;">4) provide suitable
and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all
building users <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 13pt;">5) develop a robust
management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and
published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and
published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 13pt;">6) provide suitable
access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use
of the development. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 13pt;">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 13pt;">&nbsp;The development shall be operated in
accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.<o:p></o:p></p><p>

















</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:58.45pt;mso-pagination:widow-orphan">&nbsp;</p>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the  flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
description: Conversion of dwellinghouse in three flats (2 x studio and 1 x 1 bed); two storey side to rear extension; single storey rear extension; front porch;  separate amenity space; boundary treatment; bin / cycle storage; external alterations (demolition of detached outbuilding)
